title: World Of Wonders
custom_script:
# Scene: World of Wonders
Peddy: {wow} Welcome to the ultimate *World* of Wonders! {look-around} [excited, wave, excited, magic]
Teddy: {hmm} It looks suspiciously green. Where are the *magic* buttons? {pace} [suspicious, think, calm, hmm]
Peddy: {walk-to} Buttons? This place runs on pure *adventure*, Teddy! {point} [happy, point, excited, ding]
Teddy: {uff} Adventure doesn't pay for my *snacks*. Is there a food *stand*? {shrug} [sad, shrug, calm, sigh]
Peddy: {laugh} Look at the big *trees*! Let us climb *high*! {climb:tree} {wow} [happy, wave, excited, whoosh]
Teddy: {shake-tree} Wait for me! {climb:tree} Uff, my paws are *shaking*! [scared, hips, whisper, rustle]
Peddy: {pick:mango} {eat:mango} Mmm, this *mango* is out of this world! {yay} [happy, point, excited, eat]
Teddy: {give:mango} {drop:stone} Oops! I dropped a stone instead of a *mango*! {oops} [surprised, shrug, shout, pop]
# Time skip: Walking down by the sparkling river…
# Scene: World of Wonders
Teddy: {go:river} My stomach is louder than a *train* engine. Let us *fish*! {sit:log} [hungry, point, calm, footsteps]
Peddy: {fish:river} Quiet! You will scare every *fish* in the water! {shush} [suspicious, point, whisper, splash]
Teddy: {look:fish} Ha! A giant blue *fish* just bit my *toe*! {gasp} [surprised, think, excited, splash]
Peddy: {pull} {jump} Pull it up! That is a massive *catch*! [excited, point, shout, splash]
Teddy: {pull} {fall} Oof! It pulled *me* into the river instead! {splash} [dizzy, shrug, shout, crash]
Peddy: {laugh} {swim:river} Swimming lessons starting *now*, Teddy! [happy, wave, excited, swim]
Teddy: {swim:river} {shout} The water is freezing cold! Save my *tail*! [scared, hips, shout, splash]
# Time skip: Drying off near the waterfall…
# Scene: World of Wonders
Peddy: {look:waterfall} Look at the rainbow over the *waterfall*! So pretty! {wow} [happy, point, excited, magic]
Teddy: {shake-head} Pretty doesn't dry my *fur*. Where is a *towel*? {angry} [angry, hips, shout, boing]
Peddy: {light:campfire} Boom! Instant campfire for *drying* up! {yay} [happy, point, excited, fire]
Teddy: {warm} Ah, wonderful. Now I can feel my *toes* again. {smile} [happy, idle, calm, fire]
Peddy: {pick:mushroom} Look at these glowing *mushrooms* near the *bank*! {point} [surprised, point, excited, pop]
Teddy: {sniff} Do not eat glowing things! They might turn us into *frogs*! {scared} [scared, think, whisper, rustle]
Peddy: {jump} {frog} Ribbit ribbit! Too late, I am already a *frog*! {laugh} [happy, dance, excited, boing]
Teddy: {haan} What?! Stop joking around before I *faint*! {shock} [surprised, point, shout, gasp]
# Time skip: Exploring the deep forest trails…
# Scene: World of Wonders
Peddy: {look:deer} Shh! Look at the wild *deer* drinking by the *pond*! {point} [happy, point, whisper, rustle]
Teddy: {whisper} Wow, they have majestic *horns*. Can we ride *one*? [suspicious, think, calm, footsteps]
Peddy: {shake-head} Absolutely not! They are wild *animals*, not ponies! {angry} [angry, hips, shout, fail]
Teddy: {idea} {smile} I will offer them a *cookie*. Deer love *cookies*! [happy, wave, excited, ding]
Peddy: {facepalm} You are going to get us *chased* by a deer! {sweat} [sad, shrug, shout, slap]
Teddy: {run} Run! The deer took my entire *cookie* jar! {chase} [surprised, run, excited, footsteps]
Peddy: {chase} Stop running, you will trip on a *root*! {shout} [angry, run, shout, footsteps]
# Time skip: Crossing the old wooden bridge…
# Scene: World of Wonders
Teddy: {cross:bridge} Phew! We lost the *deer*. That was close! {pant} [scared, idle, calm, footsteps]
Peddy: {cross:bridge} Look down there! A wooden *bridge* over the river! {wow} [happy, point, excited, creak]
Teddy: {look:down} It is swaying like a hammock in a *hurricane*! {scared} [scared, think, whisper, creak]
Peddy: {dance} Walk fast and keep your *balance*! We can do it! {yay} [happy, dance, excited, music]
Teddy: {slip} Whoa! My *shoe* almost fell into the *water*! {gasp} [surprised, fall, shout, splash]
Peddy: {pull} Gotcha! Never let go of my *hand*! {hug} [happy, point, excited, thud]
Teddy: {hug} You saved my life, Peddy. You are a true *hero*! [happy, idle, calm, applause]
# Time skip: Reaching the mysterious crystal tower…
# Scene: World of Wonders
Peddy: {look:crystal_tower} Behold! The grand *Crystal* Tower of Wonders! {wow} [happy, point, excited, magic]
Teddy: {hmm} It looks like a giant sparkling *ice-cream* cone! {smile} [happy, think, calm, ding]
Peddy: {open:door} Let us go *inside* and find the secret *treasure*! {yay} [happy, point, excited, door]
Teddy: {sniff} I smell something sweet. Is there a *bakery* in there? {hungry} [happy, sniff, excited, sniff]
Peddy: {enter:hut} Only one way to find *out*. Follow me! {walk-to} [happy, walk-to, excited, footsteps]
Teddy: {step-back} You go first! What if there is a *dragon*? {scared} [scared, step-back, whisper, rustle]
Peddy: {laugh} Dragons only exist in *fairy* tales, silly! {point} [happy, point, excited, laugh]
Teddy: {enter:hut} Fine, but I am holding your *backpack* the whole time! [suspicious, walk-to, calm, footsteps]
# Time skip: Inside the glowing crystal chamber…
# Scene: World of Wonders
Peddy: {wow} Look at all the floating *stars* in the air! {look-around} [excited, point, excited, magic]
Teddy: {touch} They are actually glowing *candies*! I am *dreaming*! {yay} [happy, reach, excited, pop]
Peddy: {eat:candy} Taste one! It tastes like sweet *strawberry*! {smile} [happy, eat, excited, eat]
Teddy: {eat:candy} Oh wow! I can literally float in the *air* now! {float} [surprised, jump, excited, magic]
Peddy: {laugh} {float} See? I told you this is the *World* of Wonders! {dance} [happy, dance, excited, music]
Teddy: {spin} Wheee! I am flying higher than a *bird*! {shout} [happy, dance, excited, whoosh]
Peddy: {wave} Let us fly all the way to the *moon* together! {point} [happy, wave, excited, magic]
Teddy: {yay} Best adventure *ever*! Let us stay *forever*! {smile} [happy, idle, excited, applause]
# Time skip: Evening falls over the magical land…
# Scene: World of Wonders
Peddy: {look} The sun is setting behind the *hills* now. {sunset} [happy, point, calm, rustle]
Teddy: {yawn} And my tummy is making funny *roaring* sounds. {sleep} [sad, think, calm, snore]
Peddy: {sit:log} Time to rest by the *campfire* and count the *stars*. {smile} [happy, sit, calm, fire]
Teddy: {eat:marshmallow} Good thing I saved one marshmallow for *dessert*! {yay} [happy, eat, excited, eat]
Peddy: {laugh} You always think about *food*, Teddy! {giggle} [happy, giggle, excited, laugh]
Teddy: {smile} Food is the eighth *wonder* of the world, Peddy! {nod} [happy, idle, calm, ding]
Peddy: {hug} Agreed. What a crazy, wonderful *day* this was! {love} [happy, hug, excited, magic]
Teddy: {wave} Goodbye, *World* of Wonders! Until next *time*! {bye} [happy, wave, excited, applause]
